The current bug report describes that the `Base64InputStream#read(byte[])` method incorrectly returns 0 at the end of any stream which is multiple of 3 bytes long. This behavior causes issues when using `new InputStreamReader(new Base64InputStream(in, true))`, resulting in a `java.io.IOException: Underlying input stream returned zero bytes`.
